title: Völklingen Ironworks - Wikipedia
content: # Völklingen Ironworks. The **Völklingen Ironworks** (German: ***Völklinger Hütte***) is a former blast furnace complex located in the German town of Völklingen, Saarland. As one of the only intact ironworks surviving from the 19th and early-20th centuries in Europe and North America, it was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1994 because of its exceptional preservation and its testimony to ferrous metallurgy and the Industrial Revolution. | Völklingen Ironworks is located in Germany Völklingen Ironworks  Völklingen Ironworks  Location of Völklingen Ironworks in Germany Show map of Germany  Völklingen Ironworks is located in Saarland Völklingen Ironworks  Völklingen Ironworks  Völklingen Ironworks (Saarland) Show map of Saarland | |.
